name: E. V. Smalley
mentions: E. V. Smalley, editor of the Northwest, with a party of four will be in Medora about June 1. A day's stop will be made and photographs taken of the places of interest and the points t…

…Northwest magazine, laid at Medora from Friday evening till Saturday night. There were on board Messrs. E. V. Smalley, editor of the Northwest, T. F. Kane and H. H. Lemont. A number of views of the town and abbatoirs were taken and will appear with full descriptions in subsequent number…
